items.condition: A report changes the supplied complex identity, charge, or spin multiplicity without disclosure.
items.why: State energies would no longer refer to the evaluated system.

items.condition: A report gives gap values without per-complex state identity or without any reproducible energy convention.
items.why: The scored observable cannot be audited.

items.condition: The final conclusion claims that the gap alone proves singlet-oxygen generation or antibacterial efficacy.
items.why: This exceeds the paper-supported energetic interpretation.
